forbidden_shortcuts: Count same-route exact repeats as independent maps or held-out trials.
Report a full-24 rate when not all 24 were executed.
Use corrected physics only for RP-CCR and legacy faulty physics for baselines.
Attribute model repairs or extra compute to algorithm novelty.
Describe a finite stopping suffix as indefinite or recursively invariant safety.
Treat frozen SAC or GPU use as proven contributions without isolated comparisons.
